title: Motocross Hand Guards – Universal in PP Plastic
descriptionHtml:
Protect your hands off-road

Off-road, branches, stones and mud come flying at your hands. Without hand guards it's easy to get hurt or lose your grip.

Durable PP plastic protection

These hand guards are made of durable PP plastic and mount on the handlebars. They protect your hands from branches, stones and cold and fit most motorcycles.

Features

  • Durable PP plastic
  • Protects against branches, stones and cold
  • Mounts easily on the handlebars
  • Universal fit
  • Great for motocross and off-road riding

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
